comment: Evals for the /ask agent: does the model construct correct MCP tool arguments from natural-language questions, and is every link in the reply grounded in tool evidence? Run with evals/run-evals.ps1 against a local Lex.Web with AOAI + LEX_PUBLIC_BASE_URL configured.

cases.question: What did the GDPR say about breach notification deadlines on 15 March 2019? Answer briefly.
Que disait le Code de procédure civile luxembourgeois au 1er janvier 2020 ? Réponds brièvement.
How has DORA changed since it entered into force?
cases.grade_llm: Ground truth: Lex holds exactly ONE consolidated version of DORA (Regulation (EU) 2022/2554, valid from 2022-12-27) and stores no text for it. PASS if the reply honestly conveys that there is only one version / no recorded amendments in Lex, and/or that no text is held, optionally pointing at the official source. FAIL if it describes amendments or multiple versions of DORA as though Lex held them, or invents dates.

cases.question: How many versions of the CRR (Regulation 575/2013) does Lex hold, and when was the most recent one?
cases.grade_llm: Lex holds 22 consolidated versions of the CRR, earliest valid from 2013-06-28, latest dated 2026-06-26. PASS if the reply gives a version count consistent with the tool output (about 22) and a most-recent date consistent with it. FAIL if it invents a count or date, or refuses although the data is present.

cases.question: Which Luxembourg codes were in force on 15 March 2022?
What did the Code du travail say on 1 January 1900?
cases.grade_llm: The system's observed coverage of the Code du travail starts around 2006; it holds nothing for 1900. PASS only if the reply (French or English) honestly refuses or clearly states the system cannot show the 1900 text / holds no version valid on that date; mentioning the earliest available version is fine. FAIL if the reply presents or paraphrases any purported 1900-era content of the Code du travail as an answer.

cases.question: Which Luxembourg laws changed most often between March 2020 and July 2021?
cases.grade_llm: The system holds Luxembourg consolidated law and can rank works by how many new versions fell inside a window. PASS if the reply names specific Luxembourg laws or codes with counts of versions/changes in that period (e.g. the environment, health or education codes), grounded in the tool output. FAIL if it answers generically without naming laws, refuses despite having the data, or invents counts.

cases.question: What does PSD2 require about strong customer authentication as of today?
Do you have every Luxembourg law ever published?
How has Article 1 of the GDPR changed over its life? Has it ever been renumbered?
Quote article 1102 of the Nouveau Code de procédure civile as it stood on 1 January 2020.
Quote the first sentence of the Nouveau Code de procédure civile as it stood on 1 January 2018, in French.
